test_tree_select: test tree_select to choose between two nested structures based on a boolean condition
build_tree_map_zipped: build a function that maps a zipped operation over a list of identical nested structures
create_tree_split_key: create a tree of random keys for each leaf in a nested structure from a single rng key
refactor_tree_replace_masked: refactor tree_replace_masked to replace leaf slices in a pytree where a binary mask is 1
summarize_transpose_last_axis_to_first: summarize transpose_last_axis_to_first which moves the last axis to the front for all leaves in a pytree
